curalife.title: Full Stack Developer & R&D Lead
curalife.description: Owned business-critical customer-facing product work across telemedicine and e-commerce, from product definition through production.
highlights: Defined, architected, and built a HIPAA-compliant telemedicine acquisition product end-to-end, including patient UX, backend logic, integrations, operational tooling, and GCP infrastructure.
Designed an insurance-eligibility integration layer for complex healthcare APIs, normalizing dynamic responses and failure cases while protecting sensitive health data.
The product became a major customer-acquisition funnel and led to modernization of Shopify/HubSpot customer systems.
Led frontend modernization across key commerce and acquisition journeys, improving maintainability and production workflows.
